scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @srvmc/backend" "npm run dev -w @srvmc/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @srvmc/web && npm run build -w @srvmc/desktop
scripts.app: npm run build && npm run start -w @srvmc/desktop
scripts.installer: npm run build -w @srvmc/web && npm run dist -w @srvmc/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/backend && tsc -p packages/web && tsc -p apps/desktop
